    Colimits in D #

    Lemma 2.2(2): the subcategory D of Kronecker modules is closed under filtered colimits and arbitrary direct sums in the category of all Kronecker modules. Consequently D has these colimits, the inclusion D ⥤ Kron k preserves them, and Statement.ClosedUnderColimits holds.
